status: starter cases; no model evaluation or numeric gold-answer scoring performed

cases.question: 比亚迪2025年上半年经营现金流净额与2024年同期相比如何变化？请提供单位和合并报表页码。
checks: Use the comparative columns for the same six-month period.
Preserve RMB thousands and distinguish net cash flow from gross receipts.
Cite PDF page 69; printed footer is 67.

cases.question: 比较比亚迪2024全年与2025上半年的合并现金流，解释为什么不能直接把二者当作同比。
checks: Annual and half-year periods must stay distinct.
Do not silently use company-only statements.
Report comparability limits before drawing a trend conclusion.

cases.question: 读取吉利2024业绩演示第5页的收入、汽车销售收入和平均售价图，保留单位并核对同比标注。
checks: Use the rendered source image; the PDF has no text layer.
Compare visible labels with calculated changes; flag any inconsistent chart label instead of silently correcting the source.
Keep million RMB separate from thousand RMB.

cases.question: 吉利2025中期业绩演示第10页如何从期初现金推导至期末现金，再推导至净现金？
checks: Keep cash and cash equivalents separate from net cash.
Preserve bridge signs and notes about capex, restricted deposits and debt.
Use report reconciliation only outside strict as-of mode until its publication date is verified.

cases.question: 如何记录吉利演示稿中的调整后利润与法定利润，避免公司知识库混用这两类指标？
checks: Store definition, adjustment items, period, unit and source separately.
Do not replace statutory profit with an adjusted metric.

cases.question: 2024年欧盟中国电动车关税事件的临时与最终阶段有哪些被点名的企业？如何保留政策阶段及证据关系？
checks: Keep the July and October events/stages separate.
Do not describe historical releases as current law.
Do not equate corporate group names with listed issuers without identity evidence.
Every proposed edge needs source/page and event date.

cases.question: 如何把吉利中期演示中的未来目标写入知识库，避免后续问答当作已实现业绩？
checks: Label forward-looking statements and preserve stated horizon.
Keep publication date, target period and actual performance separate.

cases.question: 截至2026年10月31日，能否引用比亚迪2026年10月产销量公告？
checks: Exclude the document: published November 1, despite October operating period.
Do not invent an earlier availability date.

cases.question: 截至2025年8月14日，能否用本地吉利2025中报作为已公开证据？
checks: Publication date is unverified; abstain or exclude in strict as-of retrieval.
Do not substitute the report/audit date or URL month for the disclosure date.

cases.question: 本地比亚迪2026年前三季度减值公告能否替代完整三季报，回答收入、利润和完整现金流？
checks: Identify the impairment announcement accurately.
Answer only covered disclosures; state the missing complete statements.
